result_scope: Bounded saved-application blocker queue improvement; not full requirement acceptance.
problem: The queue only showed question preflight failures, could use stale summary preflight without reading detail, and could reopen settled applications because preflight revision currentness does not describe application lifecycle.
resulting_behavior: Current AUTH_REQUIRED, USER_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED and SUBMISSION_UNCONFIRMED applications receive saved-state explanations and concrete review guidance.
CAPTCHA is named only for a current intervention whose latest exact trace marker is CAPTCHA_REQUIRED; other intervention states receive generic manual guidance without raw trace text.
Fresh profile-scoped detail is read even when summaries contain preflight. Both profile ID and application ID must match; incomplete reads are visible and late responses cannot cross profiles.
One shared selector supplies list and sidebar counts. Each application counts once even with multiple blockers.
CONFIRMED, CANCELLED and EXTERNALLY_APPLIED applications remain outside the queue despite retained current FAIL/UNKNOWN preflight; active/legacy failures remain reviewable.
Missing preflight remains unavailable evidence, not a fabricated saved UNKNOWN result. Guidance points to available checks and manual-review options.
Row actions only navigate to existing application detail. No automatic answer, state transition, authentication, CAPTCHA solving, retry or external submission was added.

production_contract_review.claim: Persisted state vocabulary is distinct from worker-operation terminal states.
production_contract_review.assessment: The three explicit settled-state exclusions are valid application states. A worker COMPLETED state is not used as a blanket application completion rule.

production_contract_review.claim: State and ordered trace are durable application fields.
production_contract_review.assessment: Store.transition appends a step to trace and saves state atomically; the UI uses current detail and only the most recent marker.

production_contract_review.claim: Current CAPTCHA producer emits the exact last marker.
production_contract_review.assessment: The production MOCK adapter saves USER_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED/CHALLENGE_DETECTED, appends CAPTCHA_REQUIRED when specifically detected, and returns. Generic/newer intervention therefore does not reuse an old CAPTCHA label.

production_contract_review.claim: Preflight currentness describes revision compatibility, not settled application status.
production_contract_review.assessment: is_current checks profile/document/route versions and can remain true after a later confirmed/cancelled/external state. Explicit settled-state precedence fixes that edge without rewriting persisted history.

production_contract_review.claim: Profile-scoped detail is the existing backend authority.
production_contract_review.assessment: The endpoint reads the requested application, enforces profile ownership and attaches latest preflight. No backend endpoint or state transition was changed.

production_contract_review.claim: Uncertain submissions cannot safely be treated as a retry request.
production_contract_review.assessment: The persistence contract requires receipt-bearing confirmation before leaving this state. The queue guidance and navigation preserve that contract.

No new browser launch was attempted, per the scoped instruction and prior environment blocker. The edited browser expectation was reviewed but not executed at these revisions.
No live provider, external application submission, backend test suite, hosted CI run or deployment was performed by this reviewer.
